title: Antimicrobial Stewardship and Strategies for Therapeutic Safety and Therapy Optimization in the Treatment of Patients with Hematologic Malignancies
summary: Study conducted without study-specific informed consent: retrospective, non-interventional observational study assessing antimicrobial stewardship strategies, therapeutic safety, and treatment optimization in patients with hematologic malignancies
conditions: Patients with hematological malignancy and infectious complications

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of routinely collected patient data focusing on colonization with multidrug-resistant organisms, therapeutic safety using therapeutic drug monitoring, and the optimization of prophylactic and therapeutic strategies based on these findings

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Therapy for hematological malignancy at University Hospital Heidelberg and infectious complications
Exclusion criteria:
Patients who explicitly object to the storage, processing, or dissemination of their data in anonymized form for the purpose of scientific publication will be excluded
